GRCh38 Native EVN-versus-SVN Chromosome Learning Curves

1 Scope and interpretation

This report compares native enhancer-versus-negative (EVN) and silencer-versus-negative (SVN) performance for LS-GKM and AlphaGenome using synthetic genomic backgrounds. Chr1 is validation, chr2 is held-out test, and training checkpoints cumulatively add chr3 through chrX.

EVN and SVN are different biological classification tasks, so vertical differences describe task-specific performance and should not be interpreted as paired-locus effects.

6 Reproducibility notes

  • The report uses only native evaluations from the shared native-versus-cross metric table.
  • Both methods and all three evaluation splits use common metric-axis ranges.
  • Test data are used only for final evaluation.
  • The obsolete outer-fold stability analysis is intentionally omitted.
